subject: baseline
summary: INVALID_HEADER_VALUE_CHARS_RE silently strips all characters above U+00FF (non-Latin-1 text, CJK, emoji) and control characters like \x7F, so requests go out with altered header values such as Unicode filenames, instead of throwing or encoding.
judge_reason: Same defect: the regex strips characters above U+00FF at set time, so Unicode values are lost.
